_note: FHWA's 'Toll Facilities in the United States' dataset (Socrata id tfnc-995b) is published as an href link, not a queryable Socrata table. The actual report lives at fhwa.dot.gov/policyinformation/tollpage/page00.cfm and requires HTML scraping per state. We didn't ingest it because the toll-authority registry already covers every state with truck tolls and rates come from each authority's own page.
